page.layout: Running head and page number at the top; below them two medallion portraits side by side, each with a legend around its rim; below the portraits one full-width column of text with two paragraphs; below the text a decorative ornament (not text).

main_text.p: FRANCISCVS Belleforestus Comming.ob editionem Carlaidos, Tragicarum enarrationum, Cōcionum militarium, Historiæ uniuersi orbis, Cosmographiæ, Annalium Franciæ,& innumerorum aliorum operum quę edidit,iure dici potest Ornamentum linguæ Gallicæ.Nec minus hunc mirabilem reddit summus in dicendo lepos, quam eius labor assiduus. Scripsit enim (cum vix annum ætatis suæ quadragesimum attigerit) plura volumina quam quiuis alius, & scribit[?] quotidie. Catalogum suorum operum habebis in Bibliotheca Gallica Antonij Verderij.

ANDREAS Theuetus, Engolismensis, Cosmographus Regius,terras veteribus & neotericis ignotas perlustrauit, cum nullus antea fuisset ausus optare, ne dicam aggredi nauigationem ultra nostrum Tropicum. Atque hoc iter susceptum ad quatuor mundi partes per spatium 17. annorum persecutus; Cosmographiam construxit,in qua mira refert: quod opus excusum est in folio & in duos diuisum tomos, Parisijs apud Petrum Lhullier, & Gulielmum Chauldiere.

page.notes: The two medallion portraits are engravings and carry no running text other than the legends listed above. The ornament below the text is a decorative woodcut and is not transcribed. The word "scribit" is read as "scribin" in the scan and is marked [?]. The initial words FRANCISCVS and ANDREAS are set in small capitals.
